About us

The City Rail Link is the largest infrastructure project ever to be undertaken in New Zealand. The CRL is a 3.45km twin-tunnel underground rail link up to 42 metres below the city centre transforming the downtown Britomart Transport Centre into a two-way through-station that better connects the Auckland rail network. Auckland’s annual population growth demands the completion of this complex project within tight timeframes. The CRL team are consistently challenged with tunnelling through an established city; construction on reclaimed land; the gradient of the tunnel; and the proximity of our central Britomart station to the harbour. We are proud to say we have a Safety and Sustainability lens on all of our construction work and have embraced Maori design throughout our station design. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GZ_sVPhrB7o

    A significant achievement as we move towards completion of New Zealand’s largest transport infrastructure project. City Rail Link has won the Site Safe-sponsored award for Best Governance-Level Engagement in Health & Safety at the 2026 New Zealand Workplace Health & Safety Awards. We are honoured to have been recognised alongside fellow finalists Government Health & Safety Lead and NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi. The award was accepted on behalf of CRL by Russell McMullan, CRL Ltd General Manager Assurance and Integration, at last night’s awards ceremony. CRL Chief Executive Patrick Brockie said: “We are very proud of our governance approach to health and safety on the City Rail Link project, including our highly regarded safety stage-gate process, which has played a critical role in supporting safe outcomes throughout delivery.” Organised by Thomson Reuters, publisher of Safeguard magazine, and proudly supported by WorkSafe New Zealand and ACC, the awards recognise excellence in workplace health, safety and wellbeing across New Zealand. From day one, City Rail Link Ltd and Link Alliance set out to achieve industry-leading standards in health, safety and wellbeing. This award reflects the commitment, leadership and dedication of everyone involved in delivering the project safely. Congratulations and thank you to all who have contributed to this outstanding result. #HealthAndSafety #Governance #CityRailLink #RiskManagement

    This is what testing for real people, and real journeys looks like. Tamati is visually impaired, so navigating new environments is tricky, doing it during an emergency is even harder. We’ve worked closely with our accessibility advisory groups from the design stage of City Rail Link to make sure we get it right. Now that we’re at the pointy end, they’re helping us stress test it too. From tactile ground surface indicators and high-contrast design to audio announcements, braille maps and trained staff ready to help, we’re putting CRL through real-world testing to make sure all our passengers can move safely and confidently when it counts. A huge thanks to Tamati for helping us with this important mahi.

    Behind every train journey is someone helping it run smoothly 🚆 That’s these guys 👇 our Train Managers. We’ve just ticked off a big milestone, with all 211 Train Managers now, excuse the pun, trained up and ready to guide you through the City Rail Link. They’ve been preparing for the new journeys they’ll soon take you on across Auckland, getting to know the new underground stations and tunnels, and how to support passengers and keep everyone safe along the way - all while keeping trains running on time.⌚ (Yes, they’re the ones with the whistle on the platform) This is just one part of a huge programme of readiness work happening behind the scenes. 📋 A huge shoutout to our rail operator Auckland One Rail, for completing this massive piece of mahi, taking us one step closer to opening.
